name: parks-workspace
description: Workspace for @outfitter/parks, Outfitter's design system, and its showcase.

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/parks build && tsc --noEmit -p . && bun run --cwd apps/showcase typecheck
scripts.dev: bun run --cwd packages/parks build && bun run --filter '@outfitter/parks*' dev
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/parks build && bun run --cwd apps/showcase build
